task: Iris restart/warmup/takeoff/explicit 2.5m handoff/fixed yaw/90s observation/X 32s then Y 16s then XY 16s/land/disarm
excitation: MPC_VCT_TEST=3; 12s settle; X unchanged V04 0.2*sin(2*pi*t/8)*sin(pi*t/32)^2; Y same with 16s envelope; XY 16s envelope with X=-Y and amplitude 0.2/sqrt(2); each window zero integral
authority: 用户：不用要求我授权实验起飞，一直到xy双轴实现为止
scope: PID then XY ESTA per seed; Z velocity and all rate PID; original position/attitude/HTE/land detector unchanged; Iris SITL development pairs only
safety: V04 protocol17 numeric safety, logging, timing, height, yaw, reset, saturation gates unchanged. Observation duration alone extended 60 to 90 seconds to include all three non-overlapping windows.
failure_policy: Stop on first required failure. Preserve all raw data. No automatic retry or replacement flight. An offline repair may create a separate source/seeds/budget batch under standing user authority; no relaxed numerical gates.
next: Stop after three accepted pairs and final V05 report; no V06/XYZ/hardware/push

candidate.selection: One predeclared candidate, retained X calibration and symmetric Iris XY starting choice; separately stored gains/states, no flight tuning or optimum claim

paired_gates: Each X/Y/XY window and combined 64s: each axis velocity RMSE <= 1.25*paired PID + [0.02,0.02,0.01] m/s; observation position RMSE <= 1.25*PID+0.05m per axis; yaw RMSE <=1.25*PID+0.02rad. No superiority requirement. Each window constraint fraction <=0.05 and continuous <=0.5s.
statistics: Exactly three developmental paired IMU seeds; report each window and axis, means and differences, no statistical significance or generalization claim; TV by genuine updates within each window, never compare 64s TV directly against historical 32s TV. Only IMU RNG seeded. Other sensors and scheduling not controlled.
